head: Even a public criticism can put a member in the count.
deck: The bars count statements, including remarks by former members. Only sitting members can enter the chamber tally.
note: The collection searched for names and covered selected accounts on X. Coverage varies by year.
bridge: What puts a trip in the count?
source: Hearing transcripts, congressional records, member releases and posts · 2021–2026

act: Deeper · IV · Who is touched, and how
head: A trip can count for who was on the agenda or who sponsored it.
deck: A member’s travel filing and a conference program can document the same trip. Other filings name a network group as a sponsor.
note: Staff trips count for their congressional office. An agenda lists planned participants.
bridge: How did software payments get Ted Lieu into the tally?
source: House and Senate gift-travel filings, event pages and agendas

act: Deeper · IV · Who is touched, and how
head: Ted Lieu’s campaign reported two software payments to Anthropic.
deck: Those campaign filings are enough to add a purchase record to his seat in the chamber.
note: The filings name Anthropic and list the purpose as software. The specific product and its use are unspecified.
source: Federal Election Commission · Ted Lieu for Congress disbursement reports
